settings.note: Without framelimiter, audio will de-sync in cutscenes and menu navigation will move too quickly. If using the 60 FPS patch, leave this setting at ''Auto''.
Changing to anything other than ''Auto'' causes graphical issues.
Improves performance. Warning: May slowdown the game if your CPU does not have enough threads.
Linux users are required to change to "Usleep Only" since it defaults to "As Host" there. Setting to "Usleep Only" improves performance.
